verdict.rationale: Circle is API-first: REST APIs and SDKs cover wallets, CCTP, Gateway, compliance screening, webhook management, smart contracts, StableFX and CPN, each with its own per-product OpenAPI spec. A CLI also covers wallet creation, transfers, bridging and contract execution. However, nothing in the evidence states or shows that every console/UI action has an API equivalent. Missing for 10: explicit documented UI-to-API parity, evidence that console-only functions (account, team or API-key management) are exposed via API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
